label: Cells as XORs of variables
subgoals: Write each scan cell as an XOR of injected variables
Compute each cell as the parity of its variables' values
Read the cell values in order

label: Encoding a test cube
subgoals: Turn each care bit into one GF(2) equation
Eliminate over GF(2) and check for a contradiction
Count the solutions as two to the variables minus the rank

label: Capacity
subgoals: Require linearly independent equations for guaranteed encodability
Multiply the probabilities that each new equation stays independent
Keep the care bits a margin below the variable count
